name: 14 -one & four or the other meaning-
source:
One day main character wakes up with a stone in his hand. As he learns later, he died several days ago and now exists as a spirit that is bound to disappear 49 days after his death. He needs to get behind the mystery of his death and recover lost memories of four girls.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
某天，主人公醒来，发现手中握着一块石头。之后，他才得知，自己几天前就已死亡，如今以灵魂的形式存在，并将在死后的第49天消失。他必须查明自己的死因，找回与四位女孩有关的失落记忆。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
